title: Earth Sciences Career Workshop Survey
description:
Greetings!
Welcome to the Earth Sciences Career Workshop Survey!
We, the PostDoc Potential and Climate Dialogues Way Forward (CDWF) team, are organising a career workshop for early-career researchers in earth sciences and related subjects. To this end, we want to talk to PhD scholars to get their views on postdoctoral opportunities.

The survey takes less than 5 minutes to complete and focuses on the major components that can be added to our workshop. Your experience and feedback will help us in designing the workshop effectively.
We kindly request you to take a few minutes to share your honest thoughts. All responses will remain anonymous and will be used solely for educational and research purposes.

Thank you for your help!

PostDoc Potential
